criteria.criterion: Flat 2022-2024 likely due to lower priced ad plans

reason: All six yearly ARM figures match the expected answer. The answer also says ARM stayed between $11.64 and $11.76 from 2022 to 2024, which meets the "roughly flat" criterion. It does not give the roughly 2.8% annual growth for 2019–2022. Its ~1.6% a year covers 2019–2024, a different span, so it is not a contradiction. It also does not credit the flat period to the lower-priced ad plans.
